propositions: decision_flips counts errored pairs (where one or both sides have errored=True) as decision flips because the flip comparison at parity.py:107 lacks an errored guard, despite the errored field being documented as a runtime error not a model verdict

a single transient error (e.g., ThrottlingException) on one arm of a paired run fabricates one decision flip, causing the parity slot to fail gating criterion (b) which mandates zero flips as never-acceptable

errored_pairs must be excluded from decision_flips computation and counted into a separate errored_pairs metric so that error-induced flips are attributed to criterion (d) error-rate gating rather than double-counted under criterion (b) verdict-agreement gating

the report cannot distinguish fabricated flips (from errors) from real model-quality regressions because errored_pairs are not surfaced in ParityReport.metrics, making arms with different error rates but identical flip counts produce byte-identical gating strings

an errored record with errored=True and valid=True produces a silent fabricated flip with no corroborating error-rate signal because fidelity_spot_eval.py:174 couples errored=True only with valid=False by convention, not contract

the fix adds an errored guard (a.errored or b.errored) to the decision_flips comprehension at parity.py:125-128, computes errored_pairs, surfaces it in metrics, and names it in the gating-failure string to disambiguate real vs. fabricated flips
